description: Read every field value of one object (post, term, user or options page) that the field groups located on it define: name, key, type, group, the raw stored value and an escaped HTML rendering. 404 for an unknown object, 403 when the user may not edit it (cvrt-fields 0.2.1+).

object.description: Object as ACF's post_id: a post ID ("42"), "term_5", "user_3", or the storage id of an options page ("options" for the default one)

name: fields_get_values
